title: Repulsive vs Attractive Crowding Distinctly Regulate TDP-43 Condensates through Region-specific Structural Dynamics.
authors: Zhang, Guoqing; Feng, Cibo; Chu, Xiakun
one_liner_zh: 该文用粗粒化模拟研究拥挤环境对TDP-43蛋白相分离凝聚体的区域结构动力学调控，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（TDP-43为DNA结合蛋白）但核心是蛋白自身相分离而非TF-DNA结合机制，方法为物理模拟可迁移至互作建模，故给5分。
abstract: TAR DNA-binding protein 43 (TDP-43) is crucial for RNA processing and nucleocytoplasmic transport, and its pathological aggregation marks neurodegenerative disease. The intrinsically disordered, prion-like C-terminal domain (CTD) drives liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Using residue-level coarse-grained simulations, we systematically examine how distinct macromolecular crowding environments, including repulsive (steric) and attractive (interaction-based) crowding conditions, influence the phase behavior and internal organization of TDP-43 CTD condensates. Both crowder types preserve correlations between single-chain compaction, dimerization propensity, and macroscopic phase separation, yet act through different mechanisms: repulsive crowders promote condensation via excluded-volume entropic stabilization, whereas attractive crowders modulate assembly through competitive enthalpic interactions. Region-specific spatial and orientation analyses reveal a robust internal architecture in which alpha-helices are enriched in the condensate interior (aligned roughly parallel to the interface) while intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) populate the surface with broader, outward-facing orientations. Beyond these baseline trends, our region-specific orientation maps and contact-relaxation metrics show that the character of crowding actively resculpts condensate organization: repulsive crowders compact and centralize the helical network into a single dense core layer, whereas attractive crowders redistribute helices toward the interface by sequestering contacts. This establishes a structure-dynamics decoupling with strong but short-lived helix-helix contacts versus weaker yet more persistent IDR-IDR contacts, reconciling core stabilization with interfacial fluidity. Our results define crowding class as a tunable control knob for region-specific redistribution and dynamics, suggesting testable readouts and offering mechanistic links to physiological modulators such as RNA stoichiometry, ATP levels, chaperone engagement, and client size/permeability. Collectively, our findings uncover a regulatory principle by which macromolecular crowding modulates TDP-43 condensation through distinct entropic and enthalpic contributions, offering key mechanistic insights into condensate formation and dysregulation relevant to neurodegenerative diseases.
abstract_zh: TAR DNA结合蛋白43（TDP-43）对RNA加工和核质运输至关重要，其病理性聚集标志着神经退行性疾病。内在无序的、类朊病毒样C端结构域（CTD）驱动液-液相分离（LLPS）。利用残基级粗粒化模拟，我们系统研究了不同的大分子拥挤环境，包括排斥性（空间位阻）和吸引性（基于相互作用）拥挤条件，如何影响TDP-43 CTD凝聚体的相行为及内部组织。两种拥挤剂类型均保持了单链压缩、二聚化倾向和宏观相分离之间的相关性，但通过不同机制发挥作用：排斥性拥挤剂通过排除体积熵稳定促进凝聚，而吸引性拥挤剂通过竞争性焓相互作用调节组装。区域特异性空间和取向分析揭示了一种稳健的内部架构，其中α-螺旋富集于凝聚体内部（大致平行于界面排列），而内在无序区域（IDRs）则分布于表面，具有更宽且朝外的取向。在这些基线趋势之外，我们的区域特异性取向图谱和接触弛豫指标显示，拥挤特征主动重塑凝聚体组织：排斥性拥挤剂将螺旋网络压缩并集中为单一致密核心层，而吸引性拥挤剂通过隔离接触将螺旋重新分布至界面。这建立了结构-动力学解耦，表现为强但短暂的螺旋-螺旋接触与较弱但更持久的IDR-IDR接触，从而协调核心稳定与界面流动性。我们的结果将拥挤类别定义为区域特异性重分布和动力学的可调控制旋钮，提供可测试的读数，并为生理调节因子（如RNA化学计量、ATP水平、伴侣参与及客户大小/渗透性）提供机制联系。总体而言，我们的发现揭示了一个调控原理，即大分子拥挤通过不同的熵和焓贡献调节TDP-43凝聚，为与神经退行性疾病相关的凝聚体形成和失调提供关键机制见解。
